caption: The drawing depicts a small, rounded bottle with a narrow neck and a single curved handle attached from the upper neck to the shoulder of the vessel. The bottle has a bulbous body and a short, slightly flared mouth. The predominant color of the bottle is an earthy, brownish-yellow with irregular greenish patches and some areas where the surface appears worn, revealing an underlying lighter stone color. The handle is similar in color to the body, with visible shading indicating its three-dimensionality. The bottle sits on a flat, wooden surface depicted in shades of brown. The background is plain, with a rectangular tan border framing the bottle, and above the bottle is printed text in green capital letters that reads: "SMALL BOTTLE EARLY 19th CENTURY." The artist's signature and the year “38” are visible in the lower right corner of the image.
title: Small Jug
